if: ${{ needs.mutation-plan.outputs.rust == 'true' }}
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml
the mutant leg's fetch step runs cargo fetch --locked before the baseline, so a prefix-restored cache never leaves the offline census a package short (SPEC-416 R1)

if: ${{ needs.mutation-plan.outputs.rust == 'true' }}

if: ${{ needs.mutation-plan.outputs.rust == 'true' }}
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml || true
the mutant leg's fetch step swallows nothing: a failed fetch fails the job at the fetch (SPEC-416 R2)

if: ${{ needs.mutation-plan.outputs.rust == 'true' }}
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml

        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml
the mutant leg's fetch step carries the cargo-mutants step's if:, so a plan with Rust work runs both (SPEC-416 R3)
